title: Emrys and the Confession
author: Tamsin Dravenmoor
blurb: Lior Eastwick, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
